decisions.reason: Permission to use dedicated branches in the target MVP repositories does not resume or change the deferred cleanup of legacy backend repositories.
The repository isolation policy governs where changes may be made but does not alter the requested front-end copy updates.
The accepted repository policy does not change the required fashion-source retrieval coverage.
The source decision neither resumes the deferred Shopline widget nor changes its existing-platform content source.
Repository branch isolation does not change the number or purposes of the requested attribution tools.
The source decision does not change the Google Analytics 4 integration requirement.
The source decision does not change the Microsoft Clarity integration requirement.
The repository isolation policy does not alter the usage provider, metric, granularity, or purpose of the AI usage ledger.
The accepted branch and repository constraints do not change the Stripe payment requirement or its implementation prerequisites.
The repository isolation policy does not change the usage basis of the subscription tiers.
